events.time: 14:00 ET statement, 14:30 ET presser (4:00am/4:30am AEST Thu)
events.title: FOMC decision, Summary of Economic Projections and Chair Warsh press conference (meeting Sep 15-16)
events.why: The rates catalyst of the fortnight: dot plot plus Warsh's first post-Jackson Hole presser decide whether a cut cycle starts; prices every long-duration position in the book.

events.title: US retail sales, August
events.why: Consumer pulse lands hours before the FOMC statement the same day; feeds AMZN/MELI/SE reads and the soft-landing narrative.

events.time: 08:30 ET claims + housing starts; 10:00 ET pending home sales
events.title: US jobless claims, August housing starts, and NAR August pending home sales
events.why: First rate-sensitive activity data after the FOMC; direct read for RKT and LDI volumes. Note: NAR's 2026 schedule shows no existing-home-sales release this window.

events.title: Bank of Japan monetary policy decision
events.why: Two days after the FOMC; any hike or JGB shift moves the yen carry trade that funds global tech positioning.

events.time: US cash session (expiries at open and close)
events.title: Triple witching: quarterly index futures/options and stock-option expiry plus S&P rebalance
events.why: Biggest volume day of the quarter two days after the FOMC; can exaggerate moves in crowded AI names without news.

events.title: US Treasury 2-year (Sep 22), 5-year (Sep 23) and 7-year (Sep 24) note auctions - standard month-end cycle, amounts announced Sep 17
events.why: First coupon supply test of the post-FOMC curve; a tail would pressure long-duration tech multiples. Dates follow the standard cycle, per TreasuryDirect upcoming-auctions page (13:00 ET typical close).

events.title: Meta Connect 2026: new smart glasses teased, Llama and AI roadmap
events.why: Holding; glasses/AI-device traction and any capex or superintelligence-lab commentary move META and the AI-infra basket.

events.title: Costco Q4 FY2026 results (expected date - typically last Thursday of September; not yet confirmed by Costco IR)
events.why: Macro read on the US consumer; August comps +8.4% set a high bar, and membership/traffic colour frames retail into the holidays.

events.time: 08:30 ET claims; 10:00 ET new home sales
events.title: US jobless claims and August new home sales
events.why: Labour and housing checkpoints in the post-FOMC drift; claims trend decides whether the cut narrative holds into the PCE print.

events.title: US durable goods orders (August) and University of Michigan sentiment, final September
events.why: Core capital goods orders are the cleanest non-AI capex read (TER, Keyence comps); UMich prelim printed a weak 47.8 with sticky inflation expectations.

events.title: RBA Monetary Policy Board decision (meeting Sep 28-29)
events.why: After July CPI surprised at 3.5% markets price live hike risk; the AUD move translates the whole US book on the morning after.

events.title: August PCE inflation + Q2 GDP third estimate (both moved to Sep 30 per BEA schedule; one day past this window, kept for visibility)
events.why: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge is the first big test of whatever the Sep 16 dots promised; sets the tone into October.

events.title: Micron fiscal Q4 2026 results (date per Aug 26 company notice; one day past this window, kept for visibility)
events.why: Holding and the memory-cycle bellwether: first management read on 4Q26 DRAM contract talks (guided to only +3-8%) and 2027 HBM4 pricing.
